sub_graphs.title: EIP-1108: alt_bn128 Precompile Gas Cost Reduction
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas pricing mechanism for elliptic curve operations on the alt_bn128 curve

nodes.label: Precompile Call Initiated
nodes.description: EVM execution has initiated a call to one of the alt_bn128 precompile addresses

nodes.label: Identify Precompile Type
nodes.description: Determine which precompile is being called based on target address (0x06, 0x07, or 0x08)

nodes.label: ECADD Precompile Selected
nodes.description: Call targets address 0x06 for elliptic curve point addition

nodes.label: ECMUL Precompile Selected
nodes.description: Call targets address 0x07 for elliptic curve scalar multiplication

nodes.label: Pairing Precompile Selected
nodes.description: Call targets address 0x08 for bilinear pairing check

nodes.label: Compute ECADD Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas cost as fixed 150 gas (reduced from 500)

nodes.label: Compute ECMUL Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas cost as fixed 6,000 gas (reduced from 40,000)

nodes.label: Compute Pairing Gas Cost
nodes.description: Calculate gas cost as 34,000*k + 45,000 where k = number of pairings (reduced from 80,000*k + 100,000)

nodes.label: Deduct Gas from Available
nodes.description: Subtract computed gas cost from remaining gas in execution context

nodes.label: Gas Deducted
nodes.description: Gas cost applied, execution may proceed if sufficient gas remains

nodes.label: Out of Gas
nodes.description: Insufficient gas for precompile execution - call reverts

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract invoking alt_bn128 precompiles for cryptographic operations

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1108: Precompile Execution Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the execution flow when alt_bn128 precompiles are invoked during transaction processing

nodes.label: Transaction Executing
nodes.description: EVM is executing a transaction that will call precompiles

nodes.label: Call Precompile Address
nodes.description: EVM CALL/STATICCALL instruction targets a precompile address (0x06-0x08)

nodes.label: Input Data Provided
nodes.description: Elliptic curve points and/or scalar values provided as call input

nodes.label: Execute ECADD
nodes.description: Perform elliptic curve point addition on alt_bn128 curve

nodes.label: Execute ECMUL
nodes.description: Perform scalar multiplication of point on alt_bn128 curve

nodes.label: Execute Pairing Check
nodes.description: Perform bilinear pairing check on k pairs of G1/G2 points

nodes.label: Computation Complete
nodes.description: Precompile computation finished, result available

nodes.label: Return Result to Caller
nodes.description: Return computed result (point coordinates or boolean) to calling context

nodes.label: Call Returned
nodes.description: Precompile call completed, EVM continues execution

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1108: Precompile Input Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the input validation for alt_bn128 precompile operations (unchanged by EIP but critical context)

nodes.label: Precompile Input Received
nodes.description: Raw bytes received as input to precompile

nodes.label: Validate Input Length
nodes.description: Check that input length is appropriate for the operation

nodes.label: Input Length Valid
nodes.description: Input has correct byte length for the precompile type

nodes.label: Input Length Invalid
nodes.description: Input has incorrect length - precompile fails

nodes.label: Validate Point On Curve
nodes.description: Verify that input points lie on the alt_bn128 curve

nodes.label: Point On Curve
nodes.description: Input point(s) verified to be valid curve points

nodes.label: Point Not On Curve
nodes.description: Input point fails curve membership check - precompile fails

nodes.label: Ready for Computation
nodes.description: All validation passed, precompile can execute

external_entities.name: Untrusted Caller Input
external_entities.description: Input data from potentially malicious caller contract

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify whether the gas cost changes apply retroactively to historical block execution
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume gas costs are fork-dependent - blocks before Istanbul use old costs, after use new costs

ambiguities.text: The benchmark methodology assumes 'the ecrecover gas price is fair at 3,000 gas' without justification
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Accept the benchmark baseline as a design decision; security analysis should consider if new prices still prevent DoS

implicit_assumptions.description: The benchmarked performance (25.86 gas per microsecond baseline) holds across all client implementations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Some clients may be vulnerable to DoS if their implementations are slower than benchmarked

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot craft inputs that cause worst-case execution times significantly exceeding average case
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Gas costs may be insufficient to prevent DoS attacks using adversarially-chosen inputs

implicit_assumptions.description: The underlying alt_bn128 cryptographic operations are correctly implemented in all clients
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Consensus failures if clients produce different results for the same inputs
